prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 产品对比 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "型号" · longest unbreakable word 29px · one-line width 79px
  col 2: header "价格" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 50px
  col 3: header "屏幕" · longest unbreakable word 39px · one-line width 100px
  col 4: header "续航" · longest unbreakable word 20px · one-line width 59px
  col 5: header "重量" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 39px
  col 6: header "评价" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 445px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助读者比较四款手机的价格、主要规格和使用体验。","reading":"读者可先按型号定位，再纵向比较价格和规格，最后阅读评价中的使用场景与优缺点；同一行应保持清晰的对应关系。","groups":["型号与价格共同帮助读者识别产品及其价位。","屏幕、续航和重量都是可逐列比较的规格，应保持紧凑且易于扫读。","评价是较长的描述性文字，需要更多宽度，并可借用行高自然换行。"],"keep_intact":["价格及货币符号","型号中的字母、数字和 Pro、Air、Max 等标识","屏幕尺寸、重量数值及其单位","续航数值及其单位"],"may_wrap":["评价可在自然语义边界换行，通常会决定行高。","屏幕的尺寸与显示技术可分行；较长型号也可在型号名称与后缀之间换行，并利用评价产生的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [100, 71, 105, 80, 60, 303] · table 720×275px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [100, 71, 90, 80, 60, 318] · table 720×275px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [100, 71, 90, 75, 60, 323] · table 720×275px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"型号、价格、续航和重量保持完整；屏幕尺寸与面板技术分行，四行高度一致，便于横向对应。","problems":"屏幕列比其实际分行所需更宽，却仍未能让尺寸和面板技术同处一行；评价因此略显拥挤。","cause":"屏幕列宽105px，文本区84px，小于最长单行内容所需的100px；评价列宽303px。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"屏幕仍按尺寸与面板技术清楚分行，缩窄后把更多空间给评价；型号、价格和数值单位完整，整体比较均衡。","problems":"末行评价中的“控制”被拆到两行，屏幕列也可能还有少量可回收空间。","cause":"评价列宽318px，末行文字恰好在“控”之后换行；屏幕列宽90px，文本区69px。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"评价获得三版中最多的空间，屏幕分行方式和其他列的对应关系仍清楚。","problems":"前两款手机的续航数字与“天”分离，削弱了逐列比较时的完整性；评价末行的“控制”仍被拆开。","cause":"续航列宽75px，文本区54px，不足以容纳最长的59px单行内容；评价列宽323px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"评价优先微调","widths":[100,71,85,80,60,323],"change":"以r2B为基础，将屏幕列再缩窄5px，并恢复80px续航列；尝试在保留尺寸与面板技术分行的同时，给评价更多空间。需检查屏幕尺寸是否仍完整。"},{"name":"屏幕完整优先","widths":[100,71,121,80,60,287],"change":"将屏幕列扩至121px，使最长屏幕规格有足够空间单行显示；相应缩窄评价列，检验规格更易扫读是否值得评价增加换行。"}]}
